name: Media
description: An image, video or audio source in a box sized by `width` and `height`, with `fallback` content when it fails. Native attributes and `ref` go to the ``, `

src.description: URL of the source; a missing or empty one counts as a failed load.

width.description: Width of the box: a number or numeric string is pixels, or pass a CSS length. Wins over `style.width`; default: full available width.

height.description: Height of the box: a number or numeric string is pixels, or pass a CSS length. Wins over `style.height`; default: the media's own ratio.

fallback.description: Content shown in place of the media while its source is missing or failed to load.

membrane.description: Membrane spacing around the box, for media aligned with a row of controls.

hidden.description: Hide the entire media box, including its fallback and outer spacing.

type.description: Element that renders the source: `image` (default), `video` or `audio`; the other props follow it.

alt.description: Text that stands for the image to people who cannot see it; `""` marks the image decorative.

variant.description: Frame of the image: the system radius (default), a circle cut from its center, or a bordered thumbnail.

objectFit.description: How the media fills a box whose height is set: `cover` crops, `contain` letterboxes. Default: cover for images, contain for video.

loading.description: `lazy` waits to fetch the image until it nears the viewport; `eager` (default) fetches it at once.

decoding.description: `async` (default) decodes the image off the main thread; `sync` shows it in the same frame as the content around it.

controls.description: Shows the browser's playback controls; without them only `autoPlay` or script can play the media.

autoPlay.description: Starts playback as soon as it can; most browsers block it unless the media is `muted`.

loop.description: Starts playback over from the beginning when it reaches the end.

aria-label.description: Names the player for assistive technology.

children.description: Native `<track>` elements for captions, subtitles, descriptions or chapters.

poster.description: URL of the image shown until playback starts.

playsInline.description: Plays inside the page on iPhone instead of switching to fullscreen, as a background video needs.

notes: An image is named by alt, which it requires; alt="" marks it decorative.
Name a player with aria-label or aria-labelledby; captions go in <track> children.
When the source fails and a fallback is given, the element is hidden and the fallback shows in its place.
Media fallback geometry is tokenized; width and height size the box, which the media fills, and objectFit decides how.
Native audio/video controls are browser-owned and intentionally outside Face UI control styling.
